description: The money in this brand’s creator campaigns. view balances (default): per campaign and per creator, what is accruing (earned, still in its hold), payable, owed in a payout not yet settled, paid and owed back, plus the campaign’s funds. view entries: every money event of ONE campaign (campaignId), newest first: accrual, adjustment, hold release, settlement, reversal, claw-back, recovery, fee, funding. view transfers: every creator transfer with its Stripe transfer id. Read-only, free.
